blocks.content: The first passenger train in India ran between Bori Bunder (Mumbai) and Thane on April 16, 1853.

rows: Standard major routes and heavy freight corridors
Secondary routes (mostly converted under Project Unigauge)
Mountain railways, hill stations, and heritage lines

items: Headquarters of Central Railway is located at CSMT Mumbai, while Southern Railway is headquartered in Chennai.
Exam questions frequently test track gauge dimensions: Broad Gauge is 1.676 m (5 ft 6 in), Meter Gauge is 1.0 m, and Narrow Gauge is 0.762 m / 0.610 m.
Vande Bharat Express (Train 18) is India's first indigenous semi-high speed train, manufactured at Integral Coach Factory (ICF), Chennai.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Indian Railways was nationalized in 1951 and is currently structured into 19 operational administrative zones.
The first passenger train operated on April 16, 1853, covering a distance of 34 km between Bori Bunder (Mumbai) and Thane.
Project Unigauge aims to standardize all track networks across India into Broad Gauge (1.676 meters).
Bholu, an elephant dressed as a railway guard holding a lantern, serves as the official mascot of Indian Railways.
Research Design and Standards Organisation (RDSO), the main R&D wing of Indian Railways, is headquartered in Lucknow.
